executive_summary_zh: 今天候选内容信号很弱，未见足够高价值、可直接指导后端/平台/工程负责人决策的原创技术文章。
唯一候选是 GitHub Changelog 聚合页，本身不是单篇技术深文，缺少关于 AI coding agents、评测、harness 设计、MCP 或组织落地的实质细节。
因此不建议生成完整日报；若必须跟踪，可仅把它作为后续筛查 GitHub 原始发布项的入口。
executive_summary_en: Today’s candidate set is weak, with no clearly high-signal original technical article suitable for backend/platform/engineering leads.
The only candidate is a GitHub Changelog index page rather than a substantive technical post, and it lacks concrete detail on AI coding agents, evals, harness design, MCP, or org adoption.
A full digest is not warranted; at most, treat it as a discovery entry point for later filtering into specific GitHub release notes.

items.title: GitHub Changelog
items.summary_zh: 这是 GitHub 产品更新的聚合页面，汇总了不同时间点的发布、改进与退役事项。当前候选信息只显示目录级条目，未提供足够上下文来判断其中是否有与 AI coding、开发者工具评测或工程落地相关的高价值技术内容。
items.summary_en: This is GitHub’s aggregate changelog page listing releases, improvements, and retirements across products. The candidate only exposes index-level entries and does not provide enough technical substance to evaluate whether any individual update materially advances AI coding, devtool evaluation, or engineering adoption practices.
items.why_it_matters_zh: GitHub 仍是开发者工作流的重要平台，任何与 Copilot、代码协作、仓库治理相关的发布都可能值得关注；但当前页面本身只是入口，不能直接支持策略判断或技术采纳。
items.why_it_matters_en: GitHub remains central to developer workflows, so updates touching Copilot, collaboration, or repository governance may matter. However, this page is only an index and is insufficient on its own for technical decision-making or adoption planning.
key_takeaways_zh: 这是聚合索引，不是高信号原始技术文章。
若后续需要跟踪，应点进具体发布条目再判断是否值得纳入日报。
key_takeaways_en: This is an aggregate index, not a high-signal original technical write-up.
If tracked further, only specific linked release notes should be evaluated for digest inclusion.

themes_zh: 需要从聚合页下钻到原始发布
themes_en: Insufficient source quality in the candidate set
Need to drill from aggregate pages into original release notes
implications_zh: 今天不应为了凑数而收录低密度内容，避免稀释工程情报质量。
后续抓取流程应尽量直接提供具体 GitHub 发布帖，而不是目录页。
implications_en: Do not pad the digest with low-density content today; doing so would dilute engineering intelligence quality.
Future collection should prefer specific GitHub release posts rather than top-level index pages.
what_to_ignore_zh: 把整页 changelog 当作单篇技术文章解读。
没有原文细节时，对 AI coding 相关性做过度推断。
what_to_ignore_en: Treating the entire changelog index as if it were a single technical article.
Over-inferring AI coding relevance without reading the underlying release notes.
